title: Custom Data Commons branding configuration
description: Schema for this instance's branding.json (lives at the per-instance config bucket root, served publicly and fetched by the React UI at page load). The UI reads the nested `colors`/`fonts` blocks and applies them as --brand-* CSS variables; see ui/src/hooks/use_branding.ts. One instance, one file.

metricsTile.description: One tile → one <datacommons-${type}> web component on the Key Metrics dashboard. `title` is the card's chrome header; the rest pass through as attributes.

variables.description: Space-separated StatVar DCIDs for multi-series tiles.

instance_name.description: Display name of the instance, e.g. 'India Data Commons'. Shown in the header/title.

domain_hint.description: Domain or DNS-safe label for the instance (informational).

logo.description: Path (relative to the config bucket root) or URL to the instance logo.

logo_height.description: Header logo height, e.g. "28px". Omitted, the bundled Data Commons mark renders at its natural 28px — the same size datacommons.org uses.

logo_text.description: Wordmark rendered beside the logo in the header, e.g. "Data Commons". Omit it entirely to show the logo mark alone — an instance whose logo image already contains its name wants no text here.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the logo image.

favicon.description: Path (relative to the config bucket root) or URL to the favicon.

colors.description: Brand palette. Applied as --brand-* CSS variables; each maps to a design token in ui/src/index.css with a built-in fallback, so omitted keys keep the shipped design value.

primary.description: Primary interactive color: active nav tabs, links, buttons, send button (--brand-primary → --color-teal).

accent.description: Accent color (--brand-accent). Currently has no visual consumer in the UI; reserved.

gradient_start.description: Hero 'Data Agent' heading gradient start stop (--brand-gradient-start → --color-brand-green).

gradient_end.description: Hero 'Data Agent' heading gradient end stop (--brand-gradient-end → --color-brand-teal).

surface_narrative.description: Tile behind a rendered narrative — response card and its skeleton (--brand-surface-narrative → --color-surface-narrative).

skeleton_bar.description: Skeleton ('ghost loader') bars shown while a narrative streams in (--brand-skeleton-bar → --color-skeleton-bar).

container.description: Tonal-button container, e.g. the Export button (--brand-container → --color-brand-container). Omitted, it is mixed automatically from `primary`.

on_container.description: Tonal-button label and icon (--brand-on-container → --color-on-brand-container). Omitted, it follows `primary`.

nav_active.description: Active header-tab label and underline (--brand-nav-active → --color-nav-active). Omitted, it follows `text`, which is how the neutral theme marks the active tab.

radius.description: Corner radii as CSS lengths. Applied as --brand-radius-* CSS variables; each maps to a design token in ui/src/index.css with a built-in fallback, so omitted keys keep the shipped design value.

card.description: Cards, response tiles and message bubbles (--brand-radius-card → rounded-card). Default 16px.

headline.description: Hero heading on the empty Data Agent screen, e.g. "Data agent explorer".

tagline.description: Sub-heading under `headline`, e.g. "powered by Google's Data Commons".

extra_css.description: Path (relative to the config bucket root) to an optional CSS override file.

suggestions.description: Starter prompt suggestions on the empty Data Agent screen.

suggestion_chips.description: DEPRECATED alias for `suggestions`, accepted for older uploaded files.

ga_tag_id.description: Google Analytics tag ID; empty string disables analytics.

splash_assets.description: Paths (relative to the config bucket root) to hero/splash images.

metrics.description: Key Metrics dashboard composition. When absent, the UI falls back to DEFAULT_METRICS_TABS in ui/src/components/metrics_page.tsx.
